title: Myoglobinuria (StatPearls)
claims: Evaluation of dark urine starts with a urine dipstick, which is positive for heme in patients with myoglobinuria.
Microscopic analysis of the urine in myoglobinuria reveals no red blood cells, which points to myoglobin rather than intact red cells.
Myoglobinuria presents with dark or red-coloured urine; the urine dipstick is positive for heme and microscopy shows no red blood cells.
An elevated creatine kinase level in blood confirms muscle injury as the cause of myoglobinuria.

verification.note: StatPearls Myoglobinuria 全文（Archived）；2026-11-20 把尿液表现与 CK 作用收窄到原文，删除无原文的组间比较。
